name: Blalock Seafood & Specialty Market
description: Blalock Seafood & Specialty Market is the premier source for fresh seafood on the Alabama Gulf Coast. Located in Gulf Shores, AL, our fish, seafood, and shrimp market has provided high-quality seafood and gourmet items to the region for more than 10 years. With some of the best locally caught seafood around, we're dedicated to your satisfaction. We serve our customers with pride, providing one of the widest selections of seafood in the area.
address_line_1: 1901 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542
